references.text: Also describes an eternal state of punishment for the ungodly and an eternal state of life for the righteous, similar to the parallel between eternal punishment and eternal life in Matthew 25:46.
Speaks of the eternal life of the righteous in contrast to the shame and eternal contempt of the ungodly, paralleling the contrast in Matthew 25:46.
Refers to Christ's sacrifice bringing eternal salvation to those who wait for him, in contrast to eternal punishment for those who reject him, similar to the concept in Matthew 25:46.
Talks about receiving the crown of life, which can be seen in connection with the eternal life mentioned in Matthew 25:46.
Describes the lake burning with fire and sulfur as the second death, paralleling the idea of eternal punishment in Matthew 25:46.
Refers to the second death, which is an eternal state of punishment, in parallel to eternal punishment versus eternal life in Matthew 25:46.
